Study the given pie charts and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5ac36cb2f560a5b31ade9a205aaabaa22e04dba5d3032cd01ae5431e19e7234.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbf4b163e7149d4a79bbc8943a37597b266241b7e63ac8970e8977c761f1a8c4.png] 

The number of students who appeared from institute B is what percentage more than the total numbers of students who passed from institutes A and C?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of students appeared from B = 1800 × 112°/360°

⇒ 560

Number of students passed from A = 1200 × 22/100

⇒ 264

Number of students passed from C = 12
